gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients in Cohort D will have primary CNS tumours (such as, but not limited to, meningioma, glioblastoma, astrocytoma, ependymoma, and other rare histologies).
Solid Tumor Malignancies; Brain Metastasases; Leptomeningeal Disease (LMD); Central Nervous System

candidate_evidence.quote: One-time CSF collective via lumbar puncture or Ommaya reservoir and collection of concurrent plasma of peripheral blood (liquid biopsy).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient is eligible at any time point in their treatment course, including whether or not they have already started treatment for LMD.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CSF and plasma circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA), cytology, circulating tumour cells

source_quote.quote: CSF biomarkers include cytology, ctDNA, and circulating tumor cells

coder_notes: Liquid-biopsy feasibility study (phase NA), procedure-only intervention, no drugs. Glioblastoma is named in inclusion criteria as one example of primary CNS tumours in Cohort D of a multi-cancer study, hence basket_gbm_eligible.
